mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of instances where UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases > 1% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, signaling a restrictive monetary policy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increase > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average and Real GDP (GDPC1) is growing at more than 2% YoY, it signals a strong supply-side economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO > 12-month MA and GDPC1 YoY > 2%.
